confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2008 (electronics, AED 499.00) was placed 27 Sep 2026 and delivered 29 Sep 2026.
Return was requested 9 Oct 2026 for a right earbud that will not pair; 10.4 days after delivery.
Serial EB3-40882 matches across dispatch scan, warehouse record and warehouse photo.
Weights are consistent (0.22 kg pickup, 0.21 kg received, 0.21 kg dispatch) and the timeline is in order.

findings.description: Order was placed before 1 Oct 2026 (v1 applies, 14-day window, inside) but the return was requested on or after 1 Oct 2026 (v2 applies, 7-day window for electronics, outside). The two versions give different answers.

evidence.quote: Applies to:** orders placed from 1 January 2025 to 30 September 2026.
Applies to:** return requests made on or after 1 October 2026.

policy_references.quote: Customers may return any item within **14 days** of delivery, for any reason.
A manufacturing defect that appears within **12 months** of delivery is covered even after the return window has closed.
Two policy versions could apply and give different answers

findings.rationale: Two return policy versions could apply and give different window answers (v1 inside, v2 outside), so the Return policy owner should decide which applies. The fault was confirmed at warehouse inspection and the serial matches, so the defect route (repair or replacement) may be available regardless. Code-calculated refund amount if a refund is approved is AED 499.
findings.uncertainty_note: Facts are consistent; the only open question is which policy version governs. Whether a refund, repair or replacement applies depends on that decision.
